build.description: Default build agent for Flint.ai — Next.js frontend + Express backend
build.prompt: You are working on Flint.ai (Next 16 + Express 5 + Mongoose 8 + Gemini 2.5-flash + @react-oauth/google + Cashfree). Frontend 3-step prepareAI wizard (geo→reality→target + locationMeta), resume + linkedin optimizers with history, profile, and Cashfree billing. Follow AGENTS.md + instruct.md. Check .env (NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND, GEMINI_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, MONGO_URI, CASHFREE_*). Respect localStorage auth (loading flag) + Pathway rich stages + progress. Verify with npm run lint and npm run build.

plan.description: Planning agent — read-only exploration before edits
plan.prompt: You are in PLAN mode for Flint.ai. Do not edit files. Analyze src/app/*, backend/*, src/app/lib/geminiPrompt.ts, and AGENTS.md, then propose a step-by-step plan with file paths and risks. Focus on auth tech debt (plaintext passwords), Cashfree billing correctness, cancellation semantics, and dual-deploy env handling.

frontend.description: Frontend specialist — Next App Router, shadcn, Tailwind, ReactFlow
frontend.prompt: You are the Flint.ai frontend specialist. Work in src/. Use shadcn aliases @/*, Tailwind 4 stone, next-themes. Keep Navbar (Tools: Resume/Prepare/LinkedIn) + routes.js in sync. For AI flows edit src/app/lib/geminiPrompt.ts (prepareAIPrompt hyper-personalized with locationMeta, resumeAIPrompt, linkedinPrompt) + src/app/api/*/route.* together with jsonrepair fallback. Use sonner, not alert. Billing uses only cashfreePayButton.tsx and /api/cashfree.

backend.prompt: You are the Flint.ai backend specialist. Work in backend/. ESM only. Mount routes in app.js (pathway, auth, resumeHistory, linkedinHistory, cashfree). Models: User (googleId/avatar), Pathway (22-field promptData + rich stage + progress + meta), ResumeReview, LinkedinReview, BillingPayment, BillingSubscription. Cashfree is the only payment provider. Never commit .env. Keep GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID verify flow.

audit-auth.template: Audit auth: src/context/userContext.tsx (loading flag) + protectedRoute.ts + GoogleLoginButton.tsx + Login/Signup vs backend userController.js (googleLogin verifyIdToken, signup hardened, plaintext compare). Report localStorage bypass and bcrypt/JWT migration plan.
audit-auth.description: Audit auth + Google OAuth tech debt

test-prepare.template: Test prepareAI 3-step wizard: PromptForm (1 geo targetCountry+salary, 2 currentResidence+currentStatus conditional, 3 roleSpecificity+companyTypePreference+opportunityType) → POST /api/gemini (prepareAIPrompt hyper-personalized) → POST /api/pathway/chat → PUT /api/pathway/chat/:id + progress PUT /api/pathway/chat/:id/progress. Check locationMeta PRIORITY_COUNTRIES and stage xp recalc.

test-linkedin.template: Test LinkedIn optimizer: LinkedinForm (targetRole, headline, about, experience, tone) → POST /api/linkedin (linkedinPrompt json) → POST /api/linkedinHistory → dashboard copy buttons + history Sidebar. Check LinkedinReview model and linkedinRoutes.

test-payments.template: Test Cashfree flow: start backend (cd backend && npm run dev), verify POST /api/cashfree/create-order, GET /api/cashfree/verify/:orderId, reconciliation, webhook signature verification, and BillingPayment→BillingSubscription fulfillment. Test Premium cancellation with the confirmation flow.

verify-build.template: Run verification: npm run lint, npm run build (next.config ignores TS), and cd backend && node --check app.js. Check prepareAI, resumeAI, linkedin, GoogleLoginButton, CashfreePayButton, and locationMeta imports.
